notes:
﻿Patch 0.1.17 (auto-patch)

Players on 0.1.16 can take this in-game when the patch list has a direct zip link. Until then, use Download on the website. Mega is still for first-time installs.

Loot and chests
- Ground loot and pickups fill the hotbar first when there is room.
- Chest and bag UI: Take All (R / gamepad Y) and Put All (T / gamepad X) while the panel is open.
- Shift-click moves a stack between your bag and an open chest.
- Opening a loot chest also opens your bag.
- Low-end chests roll common/uncommon weapons and armor; high-end chests roll rare/epic and named brands.

Creatures
- Creatures can hurt each other again (nightling mortar splash, rune sprites, and other creature hits).
- Heavy, fast objects that slam into you deal impact damage from mass and speed (soft bumps ignored).
- Ride bug stand height is a bit higher; clients should see the same leg raise as the host.

Controls and death
- Opening the inventory no longer gets the mouse locked again by the controls failsafe.
- Death camera stays on your corpse instead of snapping to the same wrong world point.
- Host HUD shows whether your game is on the public Join list.

Online
- Hosted games advertise to a shared public server list so Join → Refresh can find them (needs the listing Worker deployed, and TCP 7777 open for friends to connect).
- Host and client keep the same time of day / calendar.

Menu and world
- Main menu no longer draws thousands of terrain trees (laptop FPS). Play world is unchanged.
- Near tree leaves take distance fog like far tree cards (no black cutout needles in haze).

Patching
- Multi-part auto-patch join/hash work no longer freezes the menu on the main thread while a large update finishes.
- Finished download parts are kept so a restart can finish apply.
- Missing update files show a clear message instead of raw HTTP 404 text.
